visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a white sleeveless tank top is sitting in front of a white table. On the table, five black cylindrical deodorant sticks are lined up. The background is a clean indoor setting with beige curtains on the left and a minimalist shelf with small plants and a framed picture on the right. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a black deodorant stick being opened, revealing a smooth, white solid balm inside. (3) The camera alternates between the man talking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures and close-up shots of individual product containers. He holds a stick and applies it to his inner elbow and then to his wrist to demonstrate usage. (4) Close-up shots show different labels on the black sticks: 'Woodheart', 'Smokewood', 'Santal', and 'Marine'. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the products' gold-embossed labels. (5) The man brings the deodorant stick close to his face, smelling it with a satisfied expression, and then applies it to his neck. (6) The video ends with a shot of five green and black product boxes lined up on the table, followed by the man holding one stick while a red discount graphic appears on the screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 如何擁有好聞的體味?. [Subtitle]: 跟大家分享一下. (2) [Subtitle]: 我最近非常愛用的體香膏. (3) [Subtitle]: 體香膏呢有一點類似香水. (4) [Subtitle]: 但它主要會擦在你出汗的這個位置. (5) [Slogan]: LEN.嵐的天然體香膏. (6) [Subtitle]: 它不含鋁鹽 不含酒精. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以嚴格來講它並沒有止汗的這個功能在. (8) [Subtitle]: 但是呢非常非常的高. (9) [Subtitle]: 我挑三款我最喜歡的味道跟大家分享. (10) [Slogan]: 漂冬木心 WOODHEART. (11) [Subtitle]: 它聞起來很像 Le Labo 黑茶. (12) [Subtitle]: 出門前或者是運動前我會先抹. (13) [Subtitle]: 它是一個木質調 然後尾段帶一個甜甜的味道. (14) [Subtitle]: 那體香膏跟香水比較不一樣的是. (15) [Subtitle]: 香水呢它一開始噴的時候 那個味道的範圍可能比較大. (16) [Subtitle]: 但體香膏的話我覺得是 它的那個絕對距離是更近一點點的. (17) [Slogan]: 焚香癒創木 SMOKEWOOD. (18) [Subtitle]: 它聞起來呢我覺得是像 Le Labo 的東京. (19) [Subtitle]: 它的整個煙燻的木質調就更重. (20) [Subtitle]: 很有成熟男子的這種感覺. (21) [Slogan]: 檀木雪松 SANTAL. (22) [Subtitle]: 真的很好聞 是像 Le Labo 的33號. (23) [Subtitle]: 整個是更中性 我覺得女生男生都可以擦. (24) [Slogan]: 極光海洋 MARINE. (25) [Subtitle]: 這罐我就還好 但有些人可能會喜歡. (26) [Subtitle]: 我覺得它就是曠野之息的味道. (27) [Slogan]: 渣男味. (28) [Subtitle]: 跟大家推薦我們的團購. [Slogan]: 團購優惠價599. (29) [Slogan]: 請參考IG主頁連結.
